make_einsum_ensemble_mlp_enn: create a fast einsum MLP ensemble ENN with configurable output sizes and activation function
make_ensemble_mlp_with_prior_enn: build an ensemble MLP ENN with a matched prior network and configurable prior scale
make_ensemble_prior: create a JIT-compiled ensemble prior function from an MLP with fixed initialized parameters
EnsembleBranch: build a Haiku module that branches a single linear layer into a parallel ensemble using einsum
EnsembleMLP: create a parallel ensemble of MLPs with shared output sizes using einsum-based linear layers
